meta.title: AI Browser
meta.description: Open an AI-controllable browser beside the conversation, with four browser permission levels and authorization-based escalation.

mode.name: AI Browser Mode
mode.description: An AI assistant that can operate a browser: open pages, read content, click and fill in forms in the right-hand browser panel.

panel.title: AI Browser
panel.addressPlaceholder: Enter a URL and press Enter
panel.empty: Enter a URL to start browsing, or tell the AI what to do in the conversation.

permission.label: Browser permission
permission.viewHint: The AI can read the page and take screenshots, but cannot navigate or act on the page.
permission.simpleHint: The AI can navigate, reload, go back or forward, scroll and type text, but cannot click or submit forms.
permission.reviewHint: The AI can click the page and perform conservative complex actions, which go through an automatic review.
permission.fullHint: The AI can perform any browser action without further confirmation. Use it only with trusted sites and tasks.
permission.warningReview: Auto review lets the AI click the page and perform conservative complex actions. An automatic review can miss risks; make sure the site and task are trustworthy.
permission.warningFull: Full access lets the AI perform any browser action, including submitting forms, downloads and uploads, without further confirmation. These actions may be irreversible.
permission.requestApproval: The AI requests one browser action beyond the current permission

tool.blocked: The current browser permission does not allow this action
